llama-3.1-8b.name: LLaMA 3.1 8B
llama-3.1-8b.source_notes: The Hugging Face repo meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B is gated, so its config.json could not be opened from here. Numbers come from Meta's official llama-models repo (llama3_1_base_models, CoreModelId.llama3_1_8b): dim 4096, n_layers 32, n_heads 32, n_kv_heads 8, vocab 128256, ffn_dim_multiplier 1.3, multiple_of 1024. head_dim = dim / n_heads = 128. intermediate_size 14336 comes from the FFN rule in models/llama3/model.py: int(1.3 * int(2*4*4096/3)) = 14198, rounded up to a multiple of 1024 = 14336. Output layer is separate from the embedding (not tied) in that model.py. Model card (8B, GQA): https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B

qwen2.5-7b.name: Qwen2.5 7B
qwen2.5-7b.source_notes: config.json: hidden_size 3584, intermediate_size 18944, num_hidden_layers 28, num_attention_heads 28, num_key_value_heads 4, vocab_size 152064, tie_word_embeddings false. config.json has no head_dim key, so head_dim = 3584 / 28 = 128. Model card (7.61B params, 6.53B non-embedding, attention QKV bias): https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B

deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-7b.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B
deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-7b.card_params: 7B class (same Qwen2 shape as Qwen2.5-7B, 7.62B computed)
deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-7b.source_notes: Dense model (the card describes the distills as dense models; base model Qwen2.5-Math-7B). config.json: architectures Qwen2ForCausalLM, hidden_size 3584, intermediate_size 18944, num_hidden_layers 28, num_attention_heads 28, num_key_value_heads 4, vocab_size 152064, tie_word_embeddings false. Qwen2 architecture uses q/k/v bias. Card: https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B

llama-2-7b.name: LLaMA 2 7B
llama-2-7b.source_notes: Included only because the public llama.cpp GPU scoreboard benchmarks this model. meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf is gated, so config.json could not be opened. dim 4096, 32 heads, 32 layers: LLaMA paper Table 2 (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2302.13971v1). No GQA for 7B and same architecture as LLaMA 1: Llama 2 paper Table 1 and section 2.2 (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2307.09288). intermediate 11008 and vocab 32000 are not printed in either paper; they are confirmed because this shape gives exactly 6,738,415,616 parameters, the count Hugging Face reports for the GGUF used in the benchmark (https://huggingface.co/api/models/TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF?expand[]=gguf).
